olive-canopy-light.reason: Sunlit yellow-green olive crowns build volume through layered warm-green washes

village-walls-roofs.reason: Terracotta roofs and village facades build warm mid-tones and shadow glazes beneath the pen lines

valley-and-shaded-stone.reason: Cool blue-green valley and shaded stone house faces require layered cool washes and shadow depth

foliage-mid-green.reason: Mid-tone hillside olive and deciduous foliage requires progressive multi-layer wash modeling

cypress-and-deep-shadows.reason: Deep cypress spires, dark tree trunks, and shadow crevices require full five-band shadow glaze depth
